preset.name: AI engineer
preset.tagline: Models, evals, agents, and coding tools that matter
preset.description: For people who build with LLMs: the launches, evals, agent and coding-tool news, open models, and papers engineers are actually discussing, without the fundraising gossip.

focus.audience: an AI engineer who builds products with LLMs and wants to keep up with the field
care_about: New model and AI tool launches, with benchmarks, pricing, and hands-on reactions from people who tried them
Evals and benchmarks: how models are measured, what actually works, and surprising results
Agents and agent frameworks: tool calling, MCP, memory, orchestration, and real agents in production
AI coding tools and developer workflows: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and how engineers actually use them
Open-weights models, local inference, and the tooling around them (Hugging Face, vLLM, llama.cpp, MLX)
Papers and research that practitioners are discussing, and practical techniques: prompting, context engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, inference speed and cost
skip: Fundraising, valuations, revenue gossip, and hype threads with no technical substance
Politics, regulation, lawsuits, and macro or stock-market talk

topics.label: Model launches
topics.description: New AI models and model updates from labs or open-source teams, with benchmarks, pricing, and first reactions

topics.label: Coding tools
topics.description: AI coding tools and developer workflows: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, coding agents, IDEs, and how engineers use them

topics.label: Agents
topics.description: Agents and agent frameworks: tool calling, MCP, memory, orchestration, computer use, and agents in production

topics.label: Evals & benchmarks
topics.description: Evals, benchmarks, leaderboards, and careful comparisons of what models can and can't do

topics.label: Open models
topics.description: Open-weights models, local inference, quantization, and open-source AI tooling

topics.label: Papers & research
topics.description: Research papers and findings practitioners are discussing: reasoning, RL, training, interpretability, architecture

topics.label: Techniques
topics.description: Practical how-tos: prompting, context engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, inference speed and cost, production lessons

topics.label: AI business
topics.description: Fundraising, valuations, revenue, acquisitions, and hires at AI companies

topics.label: Policy
topics.description: Politics, government, regulation, lawsuits, and AI safety incidents
